name: artifact_functions
description: Discover functions without an external analyzer: .eh_frame FDEs, symbols (NID-demangled), direct call targets, optional prologue heuristic; merged and deduplicated with sources. Also saves the ps4wb-blocks-v1 basic-block artifact used by coverage tools. Input: ELF artifact or pid+module (read-only).

artifact.description: ELF artifact (or raw code with base_address). Exclusive with pid/module

base_address.description: Load address for a raw (non-ELF) artifact

pid.description: Live input: process id (read-only memory reads)

module.description: Live input: module name from module_list

linear_sweep.description: Linear-sweep executable segments for call rel32 targets (default true)

prologues.description: Add push rbp; mov rbp,rsp prologues after padding (default false; true for live input)

name: artifact_cfg
description: Basic blocks and edges of one function (recursive descent: jcc/jmp/call/ret, best-effort jump tables marked with their bound source, int3/ud2/hlt terminators, tail calls), as JSON and/or Graphviz DOT; mode=module writes the whole-module ps4wb-blocks-v1 artifact.

artifact.description: ELF artifact (or raw code with base_address). Exclusive with pid/module

base_address.description: Load address for a raw (non-ELF) artifact

pid.description: Live input: process id (read-only memory reads)

module.description: Live input: module name from module_list

linear_sweep.description: Linear-sweep executable segments for call rel32 targets (default true)

prologues.description: Add push rbp; mov rbp,rsp prologues after padding (default false; true for live input)

name: artifact_callgraph
description: Callers and callees of a function (direct calls, tail calls, PLT/import thunks and [rip+GOT] calls resolved to import names) and bounded-BFS shortest call paths to another function or import.

artifact.description: ELF artifact (or raw code with base_address). Exclusive with pid/module

base_address.description: Load address for a raw (non-ELF) artifact

pid.description: Live input: process id (read-only memory reads)

module.description: Live input: module name from module_list

linear_sweep.description: Linear-sweep executable segments for call rel32 targets (default true)

prologues.description: Add push rbp; mov rbp,rsp prologues after padding (default false; true for live input)

address.description: Function VA (or an address inside it)

to_name.description: Path target: function or import name

name: binary_diff
description: Match functions between two ELF builds (e.g. game 1.00 vs 1.01): symbol names, masked exact bytes (relocation/branch/RIP-relative/absolute-address bytes wildcarded), mnemonic hash, constants/strings, CFG shape, then call-graph neighbourhood propagation. Saves a ps4wb-bindiff-v1 artifact with confidence and method per match, unmatched and changed functions.

linear_sweep.description: Linear-sweep executable segments for call rel32 targets (default true)

prologues.description: Add push rbp; mov rbp,rsp prologues after padding (default false; true for live input)

name: annotation_port
description: Port names/labels/comments from module A to module B through a binary_diff artifact. Sources: annotation_save evidence, debug_label_save exports (with label_base), earlier ported sets, or a JSON {rva: name}. Writes a new ported set bound to module B's SHA-256 (and optionally a debug_label_load document); originals are never modified.

items.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

label_base.description: Runtime base of module A for debugger label exports

runtime_base_b.description: Runtime base of module B: also emit a debug_label_load document

artifact_a.description: Module A ELF (enables instruction alignment inside changed functions)

allow_hash_mismatch.description: Accept evidence whose module_sha256 differs from the diff's module A

name: signature_make
description: Shortest unique wildcarded AOB signature for an address (relative branches, RIP-relative displacements and absolute addresses wildcarded via instruction decoding; grown until unique in the module's executable segments, then trimmed), verified with the pattern_scan engine. Falls back to a signature on a call/lea referencing the target plus the resolve formula. Output syntax works with pattern_scan and memory_search.

artifact.description: ELF artifact (or raw code with base_address). Exclusive with pid/module

base_address.description: Load address for a raw (non-ELF) artifact

pid.description: Live input: process id (read-only memory reads)

module.description: Live input: module name from module_list

wildcard_operands.description: Also wildcard all 32/64-bit displacements and immediates

via_reference.description: Reference-site fallback (default auto: only when direct fails)

name: orbis_prototypes
description: Build or query a ps4wb-prototypes-v1 database: C declarations parsed from real headers (OpenOrbis include dir via include_dir or OO_PS4_TOOLCHAIN, or header artifacts) and/or a user JSON dictionary, keyed by computed Orbis NID; a tiny certain built-in set is marked source=builtin. action=imports lists an ELF's imports with matched prototypes.

include_dir.description: Host directory of headers (read-only, recursive, bounded)

use_sdk.description: Use $OO_PS4_TOOLCHAIN/include when include_dir is absent (default true)

items.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

dictionary.description: User JSON: prototype DB, list of {name, declaration|return+params}, or {name: declaration}

save.description: Save the database artifact (default true for build)
